title: Rise of the Pirate King
intro: The Caribbean trembles at your name.
You've conquered settlements, destroyed armadas, and built an empire.
Your fleet is the most powerful force in these waters.
But there is one who still claims dominion over the pirates of the Caribbean.
The legendary Pirate King - Captain Redbeard the Immortal.
For twenty years he has ruled from his impregnable fortress stronghold.
His fleet of captured warships has never been defeated.
Dozens of challengers have fallen before him.
This is the final battle for supremacy.
Only one captain will sail away as the undisputed Pirate King!
Will you seize the throne, or die trying?
victory: CAPTAIN REDBEARD'S FLAGSHIP BURNS!
The legendary Pirate King falls to his knees on the burning deck.
His dying words: 'Well fought... the throne... is yours...'
The fortress lowers its flags in surrender.
The surviving pirate crews bow before you.
YOU ARE NOW THE PIRATE KING OF THE CARIBBEAN!
From the smallest cove to the grandest port,
your name is spoken with fear and respect.
The Sea Rat has become a legend.
Your empire spans a hundred islands.
Your fleet controls every major trade route.
The colonial powers tremble at your approach.
The Royal Navy flees at the sight of your flag.
You started with one stolen sloop and a crew of desperate men.
Now you command an armada and rule an empire.
Long live the Pirate King!
Campaign Complete!

defeat: Your flagship explodes in a ball of flame!
Captain Redbeard's maniacal laughter echoes across the water.
Your fleet scatters in disarray as you sink beneath the waves.
You were so close to the throne...
But the Pirate King remains undefeated.
His legend grows stronger with your defeat.
The Caribbean will have to wait for another champion...
Perhaps you should rebuild your fleet and try again?
Or accept that some legends are unbeatable.
